concrete_encodings: each form row's 'word_ranges' is the exact, disjoint set of concrete primary opcode words (inclusive [lo,hi] runs, ascending) that the aggregate form represents; register numbers, quick/count/data8/vector operand values and conditions are therefore preserved. A consumer may declare an aggregate form supported only if every listed word passes; 'words' is the expanded size of the ranges
independence: test-side expectation only; derived without reading segarecomp decoder/EA masks or any oracle; never imported by production code

primary_word_partition.index: row = opcode word >> 8, column = opcode word & 0xFF

source: Motorola M68000 Family Programmer's Reference Manual (public): instruction set summary, per-instruction encodings and addressing-mode tables
target: base MC68000 only (no 68010/68020+ forms, no format/vector-offset stack word)

vocabulary.architecturally_illegal: a 16-bit primary word (or EA/size combination) with no base-MC68000 meaning: raises illegal-instruction vector 4 (partition classes I and X)
vocabulary.architecturally_reserved_exception: line-A (vector 10) and line-F (vector 11) opcode lines: defined unimplemented-instruction exceptions, not legal forms (classes A and F)
vocabulary.legal_form: an architecturally legal base-MC68000 mnemonic/form/size/EA-class combination listed in 'forms'
vocabulary.post_68000_encoding: encoding that belongs to a later family (68010/68020+); illegal on a base 68000 (class X)
vocabulary.primary_word_partition: letters A=line_a_reserved_exception, F=line_f_reserved_exception, I=illegal_reserved_unassigned, L=legal_user, P=legal_privileged, X=illegal_post_68000_encoding
vocabulary.privileged: legal form that raises privilege-violation vector 8 in user mode (class P, privilege=supervisor)
vocabulary.unsupported_by_segarecomp: MEASUREMENT-SIDE status only (assigned by the T002 coverage tool); a legal_form that segarecomp does not yet decode/lower is 'unsupported', never 'illegal'; this dataset never carries that status
vocabulary.variant: condition (Bcc/DBcc/Scc: expanded one form per condition), quick1to8/count1to8/data8/vector0to15 (operand-value variant recorded but not expanded into separate forms)
